reason: The rule states to give way to all traffic approaching from your right at a traffic island.

The rule prohibits tune-playing sirens or horns on private vehicles, implying the tone should not change.
The rule states not to reverse a vehicle unless it can be done safely.
No rule explicitly mentions checking a 'blind spot' as the last action before changing lanes.
The rule permits passing on the left when the vehicle ahead is turning right, on a multi-lane urban road, or when directed by a traffic officer.
The rule states a motor vehicle licence and disc are valid for 12 months.
The rule prohibits motorcycles under 50cc from using a freeway.
No rule directly supports any of the options as an offense for a learner's licence holder.
A Code 1 learner's licence prohibits carrying passengers on a motorcycle.
The rule states that all wheels of a motorcycle must stay in contact with the road surface at all times.
